note: 65-acre family park between Akron & Canton; overnight, weekend and seasonal guests. Near Cuyahoga Valley NP & Towpath Trail. No standalone website. --Claude
summary: Long-stay question leads: seasonal park with full-time residents, no posted nightly rate. 182 sites added, seasons added; 50A/water kept as reported; 80 ft and laundry cleared as unsupported.
flags: LONG-STAY DROP CANDIDATE, for AWH: Campendium tags it 'Full-time residents present' and describes it 'Seasonal campground weekenders welcome'. A 2022 reviewer called it 'a settled permanent trailer camp'; another was moved 'between permanent trailers'.

Five tests: (1) price unmeasured: the only rate is a camper's $35 from 2022-09-04, too old to write. (2) NOT MET on the written standard: no own site with a nightly rate, no booking site. Campers did book nights, though: a 2023 review 'called to reserve site' and a 2022 reviewer paid $35. RV Life $$ doesn't stand in for this test. (3) no minimum found. (4) unmeasured: no count of nightly sites anywhere. (5) unresolved: the permanent-trailer reviews lean toward it, and its directory listing says 'overnight, weekend, and seasonal guests'.

PRESENCE passes on Google 4.4 (97 reviews) + phone (330) 882-5678. No website on Google; ohiocamper.com's 'Visit our Web Site' link is empty. Campendium lists facebook.com/HillsideParkOfficial/. PRICE passes only on RV Life $$. Good Sam status not established on any page read.
PRICE GATE not measured beyond that; no gateway needed unless a rate over $50 turns up (Cuyahoga Valley NP is 38 km).

DIRECTORY QUALITY: the ohiocamper page (copyright 2023) contradicts itself: 142 full hookups but Sewer/Dump NO/NO, max amps 0, and 'Pets Allowed NO' against Campendium's pets allowed. A 2023 review describes a worker pumping holding tanks at the site, which fits no sewer. Its season dates are the only dated source, so treat them as soft.
Golf-cart rentals, laundry and 80 ft were in the old note and no readable page states them. Removed from the note.
Waterfront stays 'not waterfront': only a 3-acre swimming lake is described; I didn't plot sites against it.
